in_hebrew.name: יוואנלה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יואנלה הוא נגזר מהשפה העברית ומשמעותו אלוהים הוא חסד ורחמים. השם מורכב מיו״ד ה' ו-נון ומ-לה שמשמעותה אלוהים. הוא קשור לנושא החסד והרחמים האלוהיים ומהווה ביטוי לאמונה בבורא.

in_greek.name: Γιοανέλα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι χαρις και ελεος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιοανέλα προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει Ο Θεός είναι χαρις και ελεος. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με την έννοια της θείας χάριτος και ελέους, αντανακλώντας την πίστη στον Θεό ως πηγή αγάπης και συμπονίας.

in_latin.name: Joanella
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Joanella derivatur ex linguis hebraica et latina, significans Deus est gratia et misericordia. Nomen hoc reflectit naturam divinam ut fontem amoris et misericordiae, et est in usu traditionis christianae ad exprimendam fidem in Deum optimum et misericordem.

in_english.name: Joanella
in_english.long_meaning: The name Joanella originates from Hebrew roots, signifying 'God is gracious and merciful.' It is derived from the combination of 'Jo' (God) and 'Anella' (a form of 'Anna,' meaning gracious or merciful). This name embodies the Christian concept of God's grace and mercy. Historically, it reflects the biblical theme of divine benevolence and compassion. Joanella symbolizes faith in a loving and merciful God, conveying spiritual values of kindness and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Joanella is a beautiful, unique, and meaningful name with rich cultural roots. It is often used in Christian communities due to its association with various religious figures and legends. For instance, St. Joan of Arc, the famous 15th-century French warrior and martyr, is an iconic representation of the name. Other notable saints with this name include St. Joan of Valois and St. Joan of Chateauroux. By choosing the name Joanella, parents may be passing on stories of strength, faith, and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Joanella holds significant meaning, as it symbolizes God's grace and benevolence. The name reminds us that as children of God, each one of us has the ability to live a life filled with His blessings. The biblical figure of John the Baptist also shares a connection to this name, indicating a purifying and facilitating role for the bearer of this name, symbolizing spiritual transformation and a call to holiness. Overall, the name Joanella offers a beautiful reminder of God's grace and inspires its bearers (or those hearing it) to lead a life guided by God's love and guidance.

historical_references.reference: Born in 13th century Spain, Joanella was a noblewoman known for her generosity and charitable works.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Joanella remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
